notes.title: Ghostbane Release Date and Prolugue Major Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645490?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=Prologue2

Ghostbane will be released in Early Access on Steam on October 7th. We are excited to bring you our game, which has been a long time in the making, as Early Access. Our game has come a long way thanks to your feedback and support throughout the development process. 

With this update, many bugs have been fixed and performance has been improved. You can experience the changes in this update and provide feedback via Discord. Thank you for your support during the development of the game.

You can follow us on our Developer Page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/39a056aadd39d996d5fca28be9c04af9def93de0.png

Pi Bit Development Team

notes.title: Ghostbane: Prolugue Major Update
notes.notes:
Ghostbane: Prolugue continues to receive regular updates. By adding new content to the prolugue version, which is the introductory part of the game, and fixing bugs reported via Discord, we continue to keep it update and playable without bugs.

What's in this big update?


The texts in the ritual tablet have been localised in many languages! Now you can perform rituals in your own language.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/132d168d9ad98b2cf4b0e465f342e960db0dc8c6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/984d64d2792d131d5f8b3a56ffddb1ebe169b64f.png

No more lost items: You can now teleport items to this area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/48363985c16056ea3513ecb611bcbbe28fdac3bc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/463c06120273d5c8d0ec297e1f3e342709b25271.jpg

Ghost names have been localised in many languages. The screen with the names of the captured ghosts is back. (Much more coming soon...)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/d849040c259b5a7e82a94675b7da79a440ba899a.jpg

Fixed bugs in earning rewards and experience for finishing the game. You can now earn experience and money when you finish the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/c8c46adabc83d8330b148cad4622649ef444c5ec.jpg

Fixed problems with the ghost's appearance, attack and movement.

Many problems with death and revive have been solved. Fixed bugs with captured dragons.

Fixed bugs when entering and exiting screens.

The thermometer now gives evidence more easily. You can find your favourite room faster.

Russian, German and French translations have been corrected.

The ambient light has been slightly increased in the main lobby and Mansion map.

Lighting power of the Flashlight has been increased.

Fixed the issue where items dropped on the Mansion map would disappear.

Some sounds remained on in the background even if they were switched off. Sound settings errors have been fixed.

Fixed issues with placing the kittybane and ghostbane weapon on the truck.

Version information field has been added.

Fixed bugs in the camera particle.

Fixed issues with UI overlap.

Many minor bugs and performance improvements.
